newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia raises uranium purchase with Howard.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia raises uranium purchase with Howard.

text.p: Indonesia's Research and Technology Minister Jusuf Habibie indicated interest in buying Australian uranium during a meeting with Prime Minister John Howard this week, sources briefed on the meeting said on Thursday.
Howard met Habibie for 30 minutes on Tuesday during the Australian leader's first official visit to Indonesia since taking office six months ago. He left for Japan on Wednesday.
The sources said Habibie had expressed interest in purchasing uranium from Australia for Indonesia's nuclear power programme.
"The prime minister did not enter into a substantive discussion on this subject," a source said.
Habibie is pushing for the country's first nuclear power plant to be built in central Java starting in 1998 or 1999, pending the results of a study on the project.
The plan has come under fire from environmentalists on the grounds that the proposed site is in an earthquake-prone area of Java, home to about 60 percent of Indonesia's nearly 200 million people.
